body:
## Goal

Finish the separation of the shared AI corpus, the governed software factory, and the managed control plane into clear, independently operable repositories:

- [`Cratis/AI`](https://github.com/Cratis/AI) — shared AI corpus only
- [`Cratis/Ensemble`](https://github.com/Cratis/Ensemble) — governed software factory
- [`Cratis/Stagehand`](https://github.com/Cratis/Stagehand) — managed control plane
- [`Cratis/Workflows`](https://github.com/Cratis/Workflows) — organization workflow mechanics

The source/history split has happened, but an audit found operational, documentation, CI, issue-ownership, and history-purge follow-ups. This epic is the durable cross-repository checklist.

## Current safety state

AI corpus propagation and synchronization are temporarily frozen across the organization while a replacement distribution model is designed:

- 78 target wrapper workflows are manually disabled.
- Central propagation, synchronization, and bootstrap workflows are manually disabled.
- No corpus files were reverted or deleted; repositories temporarily carry mixed corpus revisions.
- Normal build/test/publish/package/Copilot workflows remain enabled.

## Workstreams

### `Cratis/AI`

- [ ] [Make the rewritten AI repository coherently corpus-only](https://github.com/Cratis/AI/issues/126)
- [ ] [Complete the approved Planner and Factory history purge](https://github.com/Cratis/AI/issues/127)

### `Cratis/Ensemble`

- [ ] [Make Ensemble independently valid and enforce all authority gates in CI](https://github.com/Cratis/Ensemble/issues/1)
- [ ] [Transfer the Factory roadmap and issue ownership from AI](https://github.com/Cratis/Ensemble/issues/2)

### `Cratis/Stagehand`

- [ ] [Finish and merge the rescued deny-by-default security work](https://github.com/Cratis/Stagehand/issues/25)
- [ ] [Establish the Stagehand product identity and safe Planner rebrand plan](https://github.com/Cratis/Stagehand/issues/26)

### `Cratis/Workflows`

- [ ] [Replace all-to-all AI corpus propagation with a controlled distribution model](https://github.com/Cratis/Workflows/issues/68)

### Organization governance

- [ ] [Restore private-repository Actions capacity and governance](https://github.com/Cratis/.github/issues/25)

## Completion criteria

- [ ] AI is a coherent corpus-only repository with generic, functional validation and gate defaults.
- [ ] Ensemble validates and evaluates successfully from a clean clone, with all authority gates in CI.
- [ ] Factory backlog ownership and documentation links point to Ensemble.
- [ ] Stagehand's rescued security work is warning-free, reviewed, verified, and merged.
- [ ] Stagehand has a documented product/repository identity and a safe rebrand/migration plan.
- [ ] A replacement AI corpus distribution model is accepted, canaried, documented, and recoverable.
- [ ] Private-repository CI can execute and required governance is decided.
- [ ] GitHub and local history-retention decisions satisfy the explicitly approved one-off purge requirement.

## Evidence baseline

- AI filtered `main` and local refs contain no removed `Source/Planner`, Factory, Contracts, or Factory documentation paths.
- GitHub still exposes old commits through pull-request refs.
- Ensemble .NET: Release clean and 195/195 specs passing.
- Ensemble without an AI corpus vocabulary: validator exits 4 with 45 errors; Python suite reports 29 failures and 96 errors.
- Ensemble with the current corpus present: validator passes, 330 Python tests pass (6 skipped), and 12/12 executable evaluations pass.
- Stagehand rescue branch: Release clean, 470/470 specs passing, but a clean Debug build reports 23 branch-introduced warnings.
- Private Ensemble and Stagehand Actions jobs were prevented from starting by the organization Actions budget.

comments.body:
The AI redesign workstream now has an accepted execution direction: **Option A+**.

`Cratis/AI` remains the canonical authoring/evaluation/generation repository, while approved public capabilities are projected into a separate bot-owned, protected, automation-managed distribution repository. The mixed AI authoring tree is never a supported public install target. Release tags, archives, passive packages, native wrappers, and marketplace submissions must derive from the same staged logical tree. `Cratis/Workflows` owns promotion, canaries, pins, rollback, emergency disable, and propagation retirement.

The maintainer authorized autonomous implementation of the complete redesign under its evidence, security, credential, vendor-review, production-action, and append-only-history gates. `Cratis/Workflows#68` remains the operational record for distribution implementation and rollout evidence; this epic remains open until the generated distribution path is implemented, canaried, recoverable, and the legacy topology is safely retired.

title: [Epic] Complete the AI / Ensemble / Stagehand repository separation
